shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A woman in a green shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat and asks about sharing breakfast with the neighbor, while a man in a white shirt sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt enters and sits in the empty place. He asks about the plan to share breakfast, and a woman in a green shirt explains the request.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt discusses sharing breakfast with the neighbor.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the dining table.
